progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ak4 and dwells most on Eb in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:08.6) introduces G, centred on Ak. Phrase 5 (0:45.5) introduces B, C, D, centred on Ak. The line peaks at F5 (731.2 Hz) at 8:55.4. It closes on D4, not the tonic (D4 → D5 → D5 → D5 → D5 → D4).
